tasks.title: Milestone 1 · Setup and case intake
tasks.detail: The walkthrough shows researcher sign-in, case creation, source provenance, image upload and preprocessing.
tasks.required_proof: The walkthrough records the demonstrated researcher workflow.

tasks.title: Milestone 2 · Artery segmentation and vessel analysis
tasks.detail: The demonstration shows a saved artery mask and centerline. Four width profiles containing 687 source-pixel samples matched after refresh and export.
tasks.required_proof: Independent anatomy and calibrated diameter validation remain open.

tasks.title: Milestone 3 · Stenosis and result review
tasks.detail: The walkthrough shows saved candidate localization, the explanation gallery and reviewed narrowing availability.
tasks.required_proof: Independent localization and severity validation and attribution faithfulness remain open.

tasks.title: Milestone 4 · Reporting and operations
tasks.detail: The walkthrough shows PDF, CSV and JSON exports, a saved CTA review and model evidence. A separate drill verified local backup and recovery.
tasks.required_proof: Target deployment and inference capacity require verification in the target environment.

tasks.title: Artery segmentation baseline
tasks.detail: Kaggle replay reproduced all 200 saved masks and probability arrays. Mean Dice was 0.8273 on this research cohort.
tasks.required_proof: Independent performance requires patient grouping and checkpoint exposure records.

tasks.title: Advanced segmentation software
tasks.detail: Attention U-Net, U-Net++ and configurable 3D prototypes were implemented. A separate U-Net++ training record is listed below.
tasks.required_proof: See the matched comparison for measured performance.

tasks.title: Generate artery masks
tasks.detail: Fresh application job 7c455aec-c2b3-4902-b76c-2677a8643836 completed; 8,927 artery pixels and six saved run-linked panels. No reference mask for image-specific accuracy.
tasks.required_proof: Actual completed model execution with saved mask and source/run identity.

tasks.title: Centerline extraction: actual application run
tasks.detail: Fresh saved centerline and graph: 797.96 px, 2 junctions, 4 endpoints. Synthetic checks pass; anatomical reference validation remains pending.
tasks.required_proof: Saved centerline, graph and geometry tests.

tasks.title: Baseline and U-Net++ comparison
tasks.detail: Matched Kaggle run 364600841 v7 compared 200 images. Baseline Dice was 0.8273 and U-Net++ Dice was 0.7861. The baseline was retained.
tasks.required_proof: A replacement requires a new eligible comparison that passes the regression gates.

tasks.title: Segmentation performance evidence
tasks.detail: Historical model reports and paired postprocessing metrics are available. The later U-Net++ comparison has its own Kaggle receipt.
tasks.required_proof: Use the source cohort and metric definition for each comparison.

tasks.title: Artery masks and binary/instance segmentation
tasks.detail: Fresh real-checkpoint execution verified the active 2D artery and stenosis-mask release, original/source linkage, saved masks, overlays, centerline, boundaries and access control. All ten connected hash-pinned task routes also executed. Binary union remains distinct from anatomical multi-vessel identification and independent clinical validation.
tasks.required_proof: Independent performance still requires an eligible locked cohort and matched references; software execution evidence is complete.

tasks.title: Segmentation postprocessing comparison
tasks.detail: Kaggle compared the fixed tiny-hole repair on 200 cases. The change failed the gain requirement and the baseline was retained.
tasks.required_proof: Any new postprocessing candidate needs a distinct hypothesis and paired regression checks.

tasks.title: Vessel structures, skeleton and centerline
tasks.detail: Synthetic centerline, branching, cycle and empty-mask tests passed. Patient-level anatomical correctness still requires matched reference evaluation.
tasks.required_proof: Saved skeleton, branches and centerline; synthetic geometry tests plus matched annotated-image checks.

tasks.title: Vessel measurements
tasks.detail: The app displays saved centerlines and widths in source pixels when available.
tasks.required_proof: Physical diameter requires image calibration and expert measurements on the same vessel segments.

tasks.title: Stenosis candidate localization
tasks.detail: Saved candidate overlays are available. The retained detector recorded mask-matching F1 of 0.4021 on its development cohort. Evaluated refinements failed their acceptance gates.
tasks.required_proof: Independent expert lesion references are needed to verify localization accuracy.

tasks.title: Normal versus abnormal classification
tasks.detail: CADICA original release documents non-lesion videos and patient IDs; exact local version, adapter inclusion, annotation completeness and model exposure still need Kaggle verification. Empty masks alone are not healthy labels.
tasks.required_proof: Verified positive/negative reference labels, patient split and held-out confusion matrix/AUC where defined.

tasks.title: Reviewed research narrowing workflow
tasks.detail: Append-only run/candidate-linked clinician measurement entry, calibrated mm attestations, percentage arithmetic and JSON/CSV/PDF history implemented/tested. Live empty history verified; no fabricated real measurements. Real reference validation remains pending.
tasks.required_proof: RBAC, case/run/candidate identity, diameter/calibration rejection, immutable snapshots and real reference validation.

tasks.title: Severity assessment
tasks.detail: The reviewed measurement workflow and synthetic grading rule passed software tests. Clinical severity stays unavailable for cases without an approved reference protocol.
tasks.required_proof: Calibrated lesion and reference diameters, expert grades and a reviewed grading protocol.

tasks.title: Advanced segmentation research
tasks.detail: U-Net++ completed a matched comparison and was rejected. Other architectures remain separate research candidates.
tasks.required_proof: Each candidate needs an eligible cohort, exact checkpoint and matched evaluation.

tasks.title: U-Net++ training record
tasks.detail: Kaggle run 364600841 v7 completed 40 epochs and 20,000 optimizer updates. Its trained candidate failed the matched acceptance gates.
tasks.required_proof: A new training trial requires its own eligible input, budget and recorded outcome.

tasks.title: Unseen patient/study evaluation
tasks.detail: CARDIAG grouping metadata was verified for all 645 samples, with no patient IDs shared across its published splits. Cross-source overlap and exact checkpoint exposure remain unverified.
tasks.required_proof: Locked holdout manifest, patient/duplicate/exposure audit, one final evaluation after candidate selection; no test tuning.

tasks.title: Compatible frozen-model ensemble
tasks.detail: Two resolutions of one checkpoint do not constitute distinct ensemble members.
tasks.required_proof: Distinct member hashes, same eligible cohort/grid/labels, fixed averaging, per-case comparison against every member.

tasks.title: Compatible dataset pooling
tasks.detail: CADICA v4 public release/license identified; local-release matching and every other member's rights, label and patient/exposure checks remain required. No pooling performed.
tasks.required_proof: Reviewed compatibility decisions, original provenance and splits preserved, no protected-test exposure.

tasks.title: Model explanations
tasks.detail: The app displays saved overlays and source-linked evidence. The attribution study remains pending.
tasks.required_proof: Run the frozen attribution diagnostic and save maps, sanity checks and faithfulness results for the pinned model.

tasks.title: Segmentation, detection and model comparison reports
tasks.detail: Fresh tests verified separate binary-mask, instance/detection and experiment-report paths, immutable run identity and JSON/CSV/PDF/Evidence ZIP exports. The UI continues to separate Dice/IoU, instance F1/AP and classification metrics and leaves undefined metrics unavailable.
tasks.required_proof: New scientific comparisons still require matched per-case references, class support and frozen evaluation definitions.

tasks.title: Saved-run dashboard
tasks.detail: Chrome restored the exact saved case and run after refresh. The mask and ordered width-profile downloads matched before and after refresh. The width evidence also matched the saved API result.
tasks.required_proof: Repeat for new release changes and any newly supported output formats.

tasks.title: Report downloads
tasks.detail: Saved 2D report identity and exports passed application tests. The authenticated PDF endpoint exported a completed 3D run alongside the existing JSON and CSV formats.
tasks.required_proof: Keep downloads tied to the authorized case and run.

tasks.title: Notifications and alerts
tasks.detail: Fresh notification and shared-workflow tests verified role-scoped inbox access, event provenance, bulk read/delete/restore behavior and deduplication. Alerts remain processing/quality notices; no unsupported clinical urgency label is generated.
tasks.required_proof: Clinical urgency labels remain prohibited until validated severity evidence exists.

tasks.title: Model versioning, comparison and rollback
tasks.detail: Fresh registry tests verified pinned hashes, available checkpoint-pair gating, audited activation history, role restrictions and explicit activate/rollback behavior. Research candidates do not activate automatically.
tasks.required_proof: Deployment approval and clinical authorization remain separate from software registry verification.

tasks.title: API, security, end-to-end and performance testing
tasks.detail: Fresh full regression passed 296 tests; focused real-checkpoint, notification, registry, reporting, security and packaging checks passed 37 tests; all connected task adapters passed 8 real execution checks; frontend production build passed. The saved 3D case records 7.89 s execution. Target-scale capacity and actual container runtime remain separate deployment gates.
tasks.required_proof: Repeat capacity and clean-container tests in the chosen deployment environment; independent model validation remains separate.

tasks.title: Offline SQLite and storage backup/restore
tasks.detail: A scoped offline snapshot restored 164 SQLite and storage files. An isolated copy served the same saved width-profile download and a CTA PDF. The local browser profile was excluded.
tasks.required_proof: Target-environment recovery, retention and encryption policy remain open.

tasks.title: Docker packaging safeguards
tasks.detail: Static non-root, healthcheck, frontend, mount, network and build-context checks pass. Not a Docker runtime/build proof.
tasks.required_proof: Static configuration checks plus a future actual clean container build/start.

tasks.title: Container runtime and deployment
tasks.detail: Docker executable unavailable on this laptop. Existing container configuration inspected; runtime build/start and deployment target remain unverified.
tasks.required_proof: Reproducible image build, clean-machine startup, health/logging checks and reviewed deployment target.
